task.intent: Get the total payment amount of the last 5 pending orders

delivered_message.plan:
1. Navigate to the Orders section of the admin dashboard.
2. Filter the order list to show only orders with the status "Pending".
3. Sort the filtered orders by date (newest first) to identify the most recent ones.
4. Identify the last 5 pending orders from the sorted list.
5. Extract the payment amount for each of these 5 orders.
6. Sum the payment amounts of these 5 orders to calculate the total.
